descriptions.value: On Intel-based macOS systems, the Okta Device Access (ODA) component of Okta Verify for macOS configures a LaunchDaemon service whose program path resolves via a symbolic link in /usr/local/bin. In environments where non-standard directory permissions grant local non-root users write access to this path, the symbolic link target can be modified, causing the LaunchDaemon to execute the replacement binary upon service restart.

descriptions.description: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
